notes.subject: תנכרו
notes.rationale: nakar — 'scrutinize/recognize' vs 'misdeem/deny': KJV 'do ye not know' vs JPS 'will ye misdeem their tokens'.

notes.subject: אתתם
notes.rationale: otot — 'signs/tokens' (evidence of the fate of the wicked) vs 'reports/monuments'; translators split.

notes.subject: to ol fren bilong Jop
notes.rationale: Job asks his friends rhetorical questions, drawing them to confirm from travelers.

translation: A, yu no askim ol man i wokabaut long rot? Na ol mak bilong ol, yu no ken waswas long ol na luksave?
